role: engineering uncertainty envelope; ranges are declared hypotheses, not calibrated confidence intervals
notes: Density randomization scales mass and all principal inertias together.
COM shifts describe uncertain mass distribution with the same principal inertia about shifted COM.
Isotropic family covers stock PhysX friction mismatch; anisotropic family retains source pair directions.
Numerical timestep is a separate solver uncertainty, not a physical parameter.
No invented anisotropic PhysX coefficient; target scalar limitation remains explicit.
Noise only changes observable gyro/acceleration fields; history masks and task bits remain exact.
Second screen adds implicitfast as a measured drive integration uncertainty, not exact PhysX emulation.
Finite-difference accelerometer mode matches target last-physics-step averaging. History vector readout noise is sampled per observation.
